ValidationRule.description: Closed Won opportunities cannot change amount or close date and cannot be reopened except to Closed Lost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Closed Won'), OR(ISCHANGED(Amount), ISCHANGED(CloseDate), AND(ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Lost')))) )
